questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “generous”:
questions.why: A generous person gives freely; a miserly one hoards. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive construction: “Someone has stolen my bag.”
questions.why: Present perfect passive: has been + past participle; drop 'someone'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “hasten”:
questions.why: To hasten is to hurry or speed up. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct conjunction: “Either you apologise ____ you leave the room.”
questions.why: Correlative pair: either ... or. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: “If it rains tomorrow, we ______ the camp.”
questions.why: First conditional: if + present, will + verb. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct option: “She ____ have informed us earlier; the delay caused confusion.”
questions.why: A past duty not done: 'should have'. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2026.

questions.q: Identify the error: “The furnitures in the new ward were donated by a trust.”
questions.why: 'Furniture' is uncountable: 'The furniture … was donated'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “She enjoys ____ novels.”
questions.why: 'Enjoy' is followed by a gerund. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: “He has been working” is an example of a sentence written in the ____ tense.
Choose the correct preposition: “She is skilled ____ solving complex problems.”
